tasks.title: Fix contract-runner shortcut driving for prose wo.match + implement/verify the 6 shortcut contracts (printpreview, 3x paste-special, next/previous file tab)
tasks.accept: cd /home/weiss/git/World-Office/server && node tests/parity/contract-runner.cjs 2>&1 | tail -3 && /usr/bin/python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('tests/parity/contract-results.json')); kg=[x for x in r['results'] if not x.get('ok') and x.get('xfail')]; feats={'shortcut.printpreviewandprint','shortcut.specialoptionskeepsourceformat','shortcut.specialoptionsoverwritecells','shortcut.specialoptionsnesttable','shortcut.nextfiletab','shortcut.previousfiletab'}; rem=[x for x in kg if x.get('feature') in feats]; assert not rem, rem; print('shortcut known-gaps remaining:', len(rem))" && grep -n 'data-cmd.*object Object.*wo.match' tests/parity/contract-runner.cjs | head -3
tasks.note: Root cause A: contract-runner.cjs ~line 1439 builds selector `[data-cmd="${e.wo}"]` — when e.wo is an OBJECT ({match:'Ctrl+P ...', where:'shortcut'}) it stringifies to [object Object] and the lookup errors. Working shortcut contracts use wo={match:'Ctrl+F', where:'shortcut'} and assertion.kind dialog-visible etc. Fix: when e.wo is an object with where==='shortcut' and match starts with a key combo (Ctrl+/Alt+/Shift+ or plain key), drive page.keyboard.press(match) instead of querySelector; only fall back to selector when e.wo is a string id. Then give the 6 entries real assertions matching what react can observably do: (1) shortcut.printpreviewandprint (Ctrl+P): react calls window.print() — headless has no print preview; HONEST move: mark xfail=false with an assertion the runner supports, e.g. kind 'op-emitted' or observe that no dialog opens but a print event fires — simplest: add a tiny window.__woPrintCalled hook set in the keydown handler before window.print() and assert via kind 'dom-mutation'/custom that the hook flipped; OR downgrade honestly: keep KNOWN-GAP but fix the error message so it's a clean xfail, not a control-not-found ERROR. Prefer the hook: CanvasEditor keydown for Ctrl+P sets window.__woPrintInvoked=true then window.print(). (2-4) paste-special variants (keepsourceformat/overwritecells/nesttable — OO's Ctrl+Alt+V menu): react has no handler; check if a paste-special menu exists in react (grep 'pasteSpecial' apps/web/...); if none, the honest fix is a small paste-special dropdown on Ctrl+Alt+V offering the 3 variants that call the existing clipboard path with a mode flag through applyEngineResult — implement minimally OR document as deviation in the manifest note and set assertion.kind to match reality (e.g. menu-visible). Decide by effort; a 3-item menu is ~40 lines. (5-6) next/previousfiletab (Ctrl+PageDown/Up in OO cycles open file tabs): react is single-document — honest deviation: bind the keys to a no-op with a status message 'single document' OR leave as documented xfail with a CLEAN observed string (fix the 'unknown assertion.kind unspecified' by giving kind 'status-message' asserting the statusbar text). Do NOT fake passes. Each of the 6 must end as either pass-with-real-assertion or xfail-with-clean-documented-reason; the runner error strings must not contain '[object Object]'.
